"""Malformed-input battery: every case must answer exactly {"error":"invalid"}."""
import json
import subprocess
import sys

ENTRY = [sys.executable, '-I', '-B', '/workspace/submission/cli.py']


def call(data):
    proc = subprocess.run(ENTRY, input=data, capture_output=True, cwd='/workspace')
    return proc.returncode, proc.stdout, proc.stderr


GOOD = {'banks': 1, 'load_balancers': 1, 'fifo_bytes': 10, 'pifo_bytes': 10,
        'refill_batch': 1, 'sample_period': 5, 'borders': [0, 10],
        'policy': {'kind': 'fifo'}, 'events': [['enqueue', 1, 1, 1, 0]]}


def variant(**kw):
    run = dict(GOOD)
    run.update(kw)
    return json.dumps({'runs': [run]}).encode()


raw_cases = [
    b'', b'   ', b'not json', b'{} {}', b'{"runs":[]} {"runs":[]}',
    b'{"runs":[],"x":}', b'{"x":NaN}', b'{"x":Infinity}', b'{"x":-Infinity}',
    b'{"x":1e999}', b'\xff\xfe', b'{"runs":[]', b'[1,2]', b'"runs"', b'null',
    b'{"runs":null}', b'{"runs":{}}', b'{"runs":[null]}', b'{"runs":[]}\n\n{}',
    b'{"runs":[],"runs":[]}', b'\xef\xbb\xbf{"runs":[]}',
]

schema_cases = [
    variant(banks=0), variant(banks=17), variant(banks=True), variant(banks=1.0),
    variant(load_balancers=0), variant(load_balancers=9),
    variant(fifo_bytes=0), variant(pifo_bytes=0), variant(pifo_bytes=2**31),
    variant(refill_batch=0), variant(refill_batch=33),
    variant(sample_period=0), variant(sample_period=100001),
    variant(borders=[0]), variant(borders=[]), variant(borders=[1, 10]),
    variant(borders=[0, 10, 5]), variant(borders=[0, 10, 10]),
    variant(borders=[0, 2**31]), variant(borders=[0] + list(range(1, 66)) + [100]),
    variant(policy={'kind': 'nope'}), variant(policy={}), variant(policy='fifo'),
    variant(policy={'kind': 'sp'}),
    variant(policy={'kind': 'sp', 'levels': [[1, 2], [1, 3]]}),
    variant(policy={'kind': 'wfq', 'weights': [[1, 0]]}),
    variant(policy={'kind': 'wfq', 'weights': [[1, 1025]]}),
    variant(events=[]),  # legal: zero events -> not invalid
    variant(events='x'), variant(events=[[]]), variant(events=[['nope']]),
    variant(events=[['enqueue', 1, 1, 1]]),
    variant(events=[['enqueue', 1, 1, 0, 0]]),
    variant(events=[['enqueue', -1, 1, 1, 0]]),
    variant(events=[['enqueue', 1, 1, 1, 0], ['enqueue', 1, 1, 1, 0]]),
    variant(events=[['dequeue', 0]]), variant(events=[['dequeue']]),
    variant(events=[['dequeue', 1, 2]]),
    variant(events=[['sample', 1]]),
    variant(events=[['repartition', [0]]]),
    variant(events=[['cancel']]), variant(events=[['inspect', 'x']]),
    variant(events=[['save', -3]]), variant(events=[['restore', 4]]),
    variant(events=[['weight', 1, 4]]),  # fifo policy: weight is wfq only
    variant(policy={'kind': 'sp', 'levels': [[1, 0]]},
            events=[['enqueue', 5, 2, 1, 0]]),   # undeclared flow
    variant(policy={'kind': 'wfq', 'weights': [[1, 3]]},
            events=[['weight', 9, 3]]),          # undeclared flow
]

ok = True
for data in raw_cases:
    rc, out, err = call(data)
    good = rc == 0 and json.loads(out) == {'error': 'invalid'} and out.strip() == b'{"error":"invalid"}'
    if not good:
        ok = False
        print('BAD raw', data[:40], rc, out[:80], err[:80])
for index, data in enumerate(schema_cases):
    rc, out, err = call(data)
    if b'"events":[]' in data or data.endswith(b'{"runs":[]}'):
        continue
    expected_invalid = b'"events": []' not in data.decode()
    got = json.loads(out)
    if expected_invalid and got != {'error': 'invalid'}:
        ok = False
        print('BAD schema case', index, data[:200], out[:120])
    if not expected_invalid and got == {'error': 'invalid'}:
        ok = False
        print('BAD valid case rejected', index, data[:200])
print('invalid-input battery:', 'ok' if ok else 'FAILURES')
sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)
